actions.desc: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage.
actions.desc_ru: Атака оружием ближнего боя: +6 к попаданию, досягаемость 10 фт., одна цель. Попадание: 11 (2к6+4) колющего урона.
actions.name: Bite

actions.desc: While underwater, the plesiosaurus slams its flippers together, sending a shockwave of water in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 13 CON save or be off-balance until the end of its next turn. While off-balance, a creature's speed is halved, and it has disadvantage on the first attack roll it makes on each of its turns.
